text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day has come to finally grant Mejiro
Palmer's
modest request—for everyone
to spend a day
with her at the
amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, the goal is to avoid getting caught
by the
zombies...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And to shoot 'em dead with these guns!
All right,
girls, let's survive this thing to
the end!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
This event is a dream come true! I can't
believe I
can play alongside my precious
Umas! How much
does this cost, and who
do I give my money to?!
choice_data_list_en: Let's play to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right, listen up, minions! I wanna see
no
zombies left standing when we're
done with 'em!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There one goes! Graaawr, just wait till I
sink my
fangs into ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hold up... I'll lure them over, so take
them out
while they're distracted!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeek, a h-horde of zombies is coming
our way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! Just calm down and take aim!
You can
do this, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer's on point with the
backup,
supporting everyone when they
need it. But I
can't help but notice she's
putting them first
again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: もっと好き勝手楽しんでおいでよ
choice_data_list_en: Go out and have fun doing whatever you want!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Come on, you gotta really sink
your teeth
into this! Otherwise, why are
we even here?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Light that soul on fire and blast some zombs, Palmer! I wanna see hunter vibes! ☆ Godlike gunslinging! ★ I wanna see you cook!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Got it! I'm counting on you to watch
our backs!
choice_data_list: サポート役は交代するよ
choice_data_list_en: We'll take turns on support duty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll be your guide, zombie horde!
Come
right this way so I can clear you
out in one go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Digital, Windy, I'm gonna go ahead, so
pick off
any stragglers for me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I've never seen Palmer take the
lead like
this before. She's so dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer on the offense is so peak!
Waheeey!
choice_data_list: 今も生き生きしてるな！
今も生き生きしてるね！
choice_data_list_en: You're still bursting with energy, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That was fun! I think I went harder
on that
than my training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Watching ya plow through those hordes
was just
like watching ya fly down the
track in a race!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You looked so badass, too! Like when
you ran at
them and were all like,
"ATTAAACK!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their laughter and cheerful voices liven
up the
night air. Today was a lot of fun.
But as I make to
head for the exit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, where do you think you're going?
Who said
you could go home?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, where do you think you're going?
Who said
you could go home?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You can't seriously be thinking of
leaving already!
We're only getting
started! Why stop here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep things going! Heck, let's play
until the
park closes! We can make
curfew if we run our
hardest... probably!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Th-this can't be! P-Palmer, of all people,
wants to
stay out late?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Whose fault do you think that is?
Now
strap in, 'cause you're all coming
along for the
ride with me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waheeey! That's more like it! Well, if
that's what
my bestie wants, I'm more
than ready to match
her energy! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, what's next? What do you all wanna
do?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You're holding back again, Palmster! Forget us for a sec, tell us what you wanna do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, I'm...

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Sniffle. Are you sure I can have your candy?

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yup! This way, both of us can have fun!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing it on purpose or anything.
It's more
like, this is just who I am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I like going all-out, yeah, but I like
helping
others, too. Both those parts
together make up
who I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You guys helped me remember that
today. So,
thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I like going all-out, yeah, but I like
helping
others, too. Both those parts
together make up
who I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, it's kinda embarrassing to say
that out
loud. Anyway, thanks, guys. I'm
really glad you're
my friends!
